target.title: fix(slack): mark connected status degraded without bot identity
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When Slack auth.test fails at boot, or channels.slack.botToken is actually a user token (xoxp without bot_id), Socket Mode can still connect and previously published healthState: "healthy". Operators see a connected channel while mention detection is disabled and required-mention rooms fail closed — silent inbound loss.

## Why This Change Was Made

Transport liveness (connected: true) is still useful, but advertising healthy is wrong when bot identity is missing. The fix adds a degraded option to publishSlackConnectedStatus that sets healthState: degraded with the identity error.

## User Impact

- Channels with missing bot identity show "degraded" instead of "healthy"
- Operators can distinguish transport-up from fully operational
- App Home and resolution formatting are unchanged (regressions from earlier branch removed)

## Evidence

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider.reconnect.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ marks socket mode healthy without seeding event liveness on connect
 ✓ marks socket mode degraded when boot identity is unavailable   ← NEW
 ✓ marks socket mode disconnected when an error closes the socket
 ✓ marks socket mode disconnected without error when the socket closes cleanly
 ✓ formats recoverable disconnects beyond the former cap as unlimited
 ✓ formats missing and unserializable socket errors without leaking undefined
 ✓ formats structured Slack socket errors
 ✓ formats shared Socket Mode connection warnings with remediation
 ✓ warns once when Slack reports a shared Socket Mode app token
 ✓ formats socket start retries with an explicit reason field
 ✓ ... (8 more)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  18 passed (18)
```

```
$ npx oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider.ts
$ npx oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider-support.ts
  No errors

$ npx oxfmt --check extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider.ts
$ npx oxfmt --check extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider-support.ts
  All matched files use the correct format
```

## What Changed

- extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider-support.ts: +14/-0 (degraded option for publishSlackConnectedStatus)
- extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider.ts: +13/-2 (identityDegraded detection + forward to callback)
- extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider.reconnect.test.ts: +18/-0 (degraded status test)

Fixes #105556
